summary: 1 blocking finding applies: gate failure entries can signal failure through level, so R2 must include level in important-entry criteria.

items.title: Gate failures are not covered by the specified failure fields
items.rationale: The finding matches the current gate issue-log writer. Gate failure entries may not include result, status, or failureKind, so the spec must classify failing level values as important.
items.evidence: src/flow/lib/run-gate.js appendIssueLogFromGateResult writes step, level, phase, reason, trigger, timestamp, observations, and passedGuardrails. It does not write result/status/failureKind.
